title: Integrate final rehearsal source
goal: After T005 and T006 are terminal and independently reviewed, combine the exact T006 integrated T001/T002 revision with the exact standalone T005 rehearsal-harness patch inside the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree, establish one final reviewed non-main Heim-PC source revision, and create the leased content-addressed whole-source artifact that T003 must consume without reading the live Git object store or mutable checkout.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store only through its Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree and run-scoped non-main workspace branch, and may create the bound rehearsal-source artifact. The exact T006 integrated revision and exact standalone T005 patch are immutable reviewed inputs; T007 owns their integration. Workspace path, branch and frozen baseline are generated and recorded by Bureau for the exact run rather than being fixed shared names in the TaskSpec. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: T007 begins only after T006 and T005 are terminal and independently reviewed. Evidence separately binds the exact T006 integration commit/tree and the exact T005 standalone terminal commit/tree together with their reviewed task evidence and canonical architecture lineage. T005 is not required to descend from T006; T007 is the sole task authorized to combine these two reviewed lineages. Missing source identity, dirty state or ambiguity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading commit/tree objects or creating final-integration refs, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

Before the first Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains a non-null Bureau workspace whose workspace_path, workspace_branch, baseline_commit and source_head_at_intent are bound to this exact run. All final integration mutation and validation occurs only there; a missing workspace, reused fixed integration worktree, branch mismatch, dirty preimage or run/workspace identity drift fails closed.

Inside the exact run-scoped workspace, a receipt-bound merge/rebase/cherry-pick plan combines exactly the reviewed T006 integrated revision and the reviewed standalone T005 component delta. Any conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree/diff comparison proves the final revision contains the intended T006 source plus T005 rehearsal changes and no unrelated source change.

The exact final integration revision is published only from the Bureau-recorded run-scoped non-main workspace branch, and remote readback proves the published ref resolves to the reviewed commit/tree. T003 receives exact commit/tree identities, never a moving ref as authority.

Focused T001/T002/T005 tests plus required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the exact run-scoped final-integration worktree on the exact final integration revision, and independent review finds no material integration regression before the rehearsal-source artifact is published.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source write claim, T007 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed final integration revision. The manifest binds Git commit/tree, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the bound source tree.

The T007 terminal evidence designates the exact final integration commit/tree and content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact as T003's only declarative/reconstruction source. T003 fails closed if the artifact digest, manifest, source commit/tree or Control Release Set/lock binding differs.
T007 performs no main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.

metadata.workspace_contract: Bureau run-scoped worktree and non-main branch recorded in the execution envelope
